visual.general_description: Single grayscale axial brain MRI slice at orbital/temporal-lobe level (caption: FLAIR sequence at the hippocampal level) with no text, arrows or panel letters.
visual.detailed_description: 750 x 956 pixel grayscale axial slice. Axial slice through the orbits anteriorly, the temporal lobes on both sides and the midbrain in the centre. Both globes appear as dark rounded structures with bright periorbital fat at the medial/lateral margins; midline nasal/ethmoid structures lie anteriorly. Curvilinear dark fluid-signal spaces run anteroposteriorly on each side lateral to the brainstem (temporal horns/atria region). Gray matter and white matter show low contrast. A small dark focus lies at the midline in the posterior brainstem region. A few thin bright linear signals lie along the posterior image-right and image-left periphery near the occipital region. A thin bright ring of scalp fat/skin surrounds the head. A small loop-shaped soft-tissue outline projects from the scalp at the right edge of the image (external ear contour). The image contains no panel letters, text labels, orientation markers, arrows, scale bar, annotations or measurements. Caption-derived content: FLAIR sequence, hippocampal level, negative study; these are author statements and are not re-derived from the pixels.
